body: Old done tasks, cards whose file is gone, expired locks. Owner asked on 2026-11-11 that sati not bloat with tasks or tests.

completion.releaseNote: sati doctor shows a lean line; sati doctor --fix releases expired locks and removes cards whose file is gone.
completion.summary: Commit 09bf6ae. doctor prints an informational lean line: cards whose file is gone (not on disk and on no git branch; glob cards skipped) and finished tasks older than 90 days. doctor --fix releases expired locks and removes those cards in one logged transaction (core leanReport, leanCleanup). Finished tasks are counted, not removed: tombstones stay in .sati/, so deleting frees nothing. Tests: CLI doctor --fix (gone card removed, other-branch card and anchored card kept), core lock cleanup. Full suite passes.

title: 9f Lean check: doctor reports bloat and a cleanup command removes it
